description_en: Creates a data validation task with specified source and destination data sources, validation type, and scheduling mode
description_zh: 创建一个新的数据校验任务，指定源端与目标端数据源、校验类型及调度方式
kebab_example: aliyun lhm add-data-check-task --check-template-id 1001 --check-type 0 --dst-ds-id 2001 --dst-ds-name ds_demo --dst-ds-type Hive --src-ds-id 1001 --src-ds-name ds_demo --src-ds-type Hive --task-mode 0 --task-name data_check_task_demo --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataCheckTask

parameters.help_en: The validation template ID. If not specified, the built-in default template is used
parameters.help_zh: 校验模板 ID（不传则使用内置默认模板）
parameters.name: check_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The validation type. Valid values:

0: data volume comparison.
1: metric comparison.
2: weak content comparison
parameters.help_zh: 校验类型：0-数据量比对 1-指标比对 2-弱内容对比
parameters.name: check_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination data source
parameters.name: dst_ds_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination data source
parameters.name: dst_ds_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination data source
parameters.name: dst_ds_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source data source
parameters.name: src_ds_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the source data source
parameters.name: src_ds_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the source data source
parameters.name: src_ds_type

parameters.help_en:
The table detail creation mode. Valid values:

0: table-by-table fine-grained creation.
1: batch creation with the same schema
parameters.help_zh: 参数创建方式：0-逐表精细化创建 1-同模式批量创建
parameters.name: task_mode

parameters.help_en: The task name. Only Chinese characters, English characters, and digits are supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称（仅中英文和数字）
parameters.name: task_name

data.description_en: The task ID of the newly created validation task. Use this ID for subsequent operations such as configuring table details, executing validations, or deleting the task
data.description_zh: 新建校验任务的任务 ID，后续为该任务配置表明细、执行校验或删除任务均以此 ID 为准

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Use errCode and errMessage to identify the cause
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
